name: Casasimarro (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical stripes, white at the hoist charged with a red house and red at the fly.
history: The flag, approved in 2005 (Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha no. 241 of 30 November 2005), is described as a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of two equal vertical stripes, white with a red house at the hoist and red at the fly.
